description: A byte array and the time stamps of four 200 ms steps (the same example on the Mega 2560).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (recorded on a real Uno R3, class hardware) holds for the Mega 2560: the sketch uses no feature in which the ATmega328P and the ATmega2560 differ (no pin above 13, A0 as ADC channel 0, 16 MHz, 16-bit int, same core 1.8.8); no recording on a Mega exists

tolerances.reason: millis() granularity of 1 ms per delay(200) and the few microseconds of the loop body, summed over up to three steps
